import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;

    static class Edge {
        int v, c;
        Edge(int v, int c) {
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n, m, source, sink;
        List<Integer>[] e;
        Edge[] edge;

        FlowNetwork() {
            e = new List[MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
                e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            edge = new Edge[MAXM * 2];
        }

        void init(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = 0;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                e[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
            edge[m] = new Edge(b, c);
            e[a].add(m);
            edge[m + 1] = new Edge(a, 0);
            e[b].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        int[] dist_count = new int[MAXN];
        int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
        int[] done = new int[MAXN];
        int[] path = new int[MAXN];
        int path_len;

        void compute_distances() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            Arrays.fill(dist_count, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, n);
            dist[sink] = 0;
            q.offer(sink);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                ++dist_count[dist[cur]];
                for (int id : e[cur]) {
                    if (dist[edge[id].v] == n && edge[id ^ 1].c > 0) {
                        dist[edge[id].v] = dist[cur] + 1;
                        q.offer(edge[id].v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void restore_distance(int v) {
            --dist_count[dist[v]];
            dist[v] = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < e[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge arc = edge[e[v].get(i)];
                if (dist[v] > dist[arc.v] + 1 && arc.c > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[arc.v] + 1;
                    done[v] = i;
                }
            }
            ++dist_count[dist[v]];
        }

        int augment_path() {
            int bottleneck_vertex = -1;
            int flow = 0x7fffff;
            for (int i = 0; i < path_len; ++i) {
                Edge arc = edge[e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]])];
                if (arc.c < flow) {
                    flow = arc.c;
                    bottleneck_vertex = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < path_len; ++i) {
                int id = e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]);
                edge[id].c -= flow;
                edge[id ^ 1].c += flow;
            }
            path_len = bottleneck_vertex;
            return flow;
        }

        int max_flow() {
            int flow = 0;
            compute_distances();
            Arrays.fill(done, 0);
            path_len = 0;
            path[0] = source;
            while (dist[source] != n) {
                int current = path[path_len];
                if (current == sink) {
                    flow += augment_path();
                } else {
                    while (done[current] < e[current].size()) {
                        Edge arc = edge[e[current].get(done[current])];
                        if (dist[arc.v] == dist[current] - 1 && arc.c > 0) {
                            break;
                        }
                        ++done[current];
                    }
                    if (done[current] == e[current].size()) {
                        if (dist_count[dist[current]] == 1) {
                            break;
                        }
                        restore_distance(current);
                        if (current != source) {
                            --path_len;
                        }
                    } else {
                        path[++path_len] = edge[e[current].get(done[current])].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) flow--;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int[] d_row = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] d_col = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int grid_size;
    static char[][] source_grid = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] dest_grid = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] dist_from_z = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] travel_time = new int[MAX][MAX];

    static int encode_source(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int encode_dest(int i, int j) { return MAX*MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int get_source_node() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int get_sink_node() { return get_source_node() + 1; }
    static int total_nodes() { return get_sink_node() + 1; }

    static void compute_distances_to_z(int size) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                dist_from_z[i][j] = INF;
                if (source_grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist_from_z[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + d_row[k];
                int ny = y + d_col[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size
                    && Character.isDigit(source_grid[nx][ny]) && dist_from_z[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist_from_z[nx][ny] = dist_from_z[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build_path(int size, int max_time, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j)
                travel_time[i][j] = INF;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        travel_time[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (travel_time[x][y] > max_time) break;
            if (travel_time[x][y] <= dist_from_z[x][y] && Character.isDigit(dest_grid[x][y]) && dest_grid[x][y] != '0') {
                fn.addEdge(encode_source(sx, sy), encode_dest(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (travel_time[x][y] >= dist_from_z[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + d_row[k];
                int ny = y + d_col[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size
                    && Character.isDigit(source_grid[nx][ny]) && travel_time[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    travel_time[nx][ny] = travel_time[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static FlowNetwork fn = new FlowNetwork();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        fn.init(total_nodes(), get_source_node(), get_sink_node());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            source_grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(source_grid[i][j]) && source_grid[i][j] != '0') {
                    fn.addEdge(get_source_node(), encode_source(i, j), source_grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            dest_grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(dest_grid[i][j]) && dest_grid[i][j] != '0') {
                    fn.addEdge(encode_dest(i, j), get_sink_node(), dest_grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        compute_distances_to_z(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(source_grid[i][j]) && source_grid[i][j] != '0') {
                    build_path(n, m, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(fn.max_flow());
    }
}
